_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 17 — arm 12 (single-layer canonical) + CARD LV-2, the rx-CB carry
COMMON-MODE DE-MEAN (docs/SPEC_level_information_budget.md).  Single knob:
network.rx_cb_carry_demean.  Carry stays ON -- that is the point: arm 14 proved the
carry's per-station DIFFERENCE rigidity load-bearing (turning it off free-falls a00 at
-9 TECU/ep), so the fix is to remove only its net FRAME force.
MECHANISM.  Each fold injects eta_i = lambda_i * (innov_i - mu) instead of
lambda_i * innov_i, with mu = SUM(lambda*innov)/SUM(lambda) over every station that
actually FOLDED that code-bias family, computed at the SERIAL post-solve harvest and
applied LAG-1 (the produce phase only reads it -- race-free by construction, the
Iono-2 v3 rep_error_demean idiom).  SUM lambda*(innov-mu) = 0 identically, so the
carry keeps every between-station difference at full stiffness while exerting ZERO net
force on the DCB common mode -- a FRAME direction that belongs to the designed
authority (rx_code_bias_datum's 1/sigma^2 = 0.01, the a00 GIM anchor's 0.25), not to
last epoch's realization (~100 info units).  The 10-sigma inject gate judges
|innov - mu| too: a coherent frame move is not a per-receiver hardware jump and must
not mass-trigger the receiver-reset response.
This is a REAL actuator, unlike LV-1: it changes a prior row's RHS by -lambda*mu, and
no linearization-frame algebra compensates that (see arm 15/16's headers).
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN:
- The inject-gate skip rate collapses from arm 13's ~58 % (run-end LV-2 line prints
skips/(skips+folds) on the demeaned innovation).  If it does NOT move, mu is tiny
compared with the per-station spread and the 58 % is a FRAME artifact of a frozen
x_lin(cb) rather than a coherent common-mode move -- in which case LV-1 (which
re-centres x_lin(cb)) is the knob that fixes it, and arm 19 shows that.
- Ignition trajectory similar or mildly improved vs arm 12 (ignition ~24.7, trough
~6-7 rising by ~ep 16, gate 0/0/0, in-band 20/20).  LV-2 targets the BREATHING
(the +/-6 TECU 20-30 min cycle of arms 11/13), which 20 epochs cannot show.
- mu itself, traced per epoch as `lv2_mu` rows in network_events.csv, sits near zero
in a healthy epoch and swings during a frame move.  A mu that grows monotonically
is the flywheel being drained and is the headline plot of this card.
- lv2_mu_frozen should be 0 at 61 stations (floor is 8 contributing stations); any
freeze marks an epoch whose folded set collapsed -- name it before reading mu.
